infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: PASER records your route while you run so you can claim the area you enclose. Your route is only tracked during an active run.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: PASER records your route while you run so you can claim the area you enclose. Background access only keeps an active run recording when the screen is off.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: Motion data verifies your runs are on foot.
infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: PASER does not read your health data.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: PASER can save your finished runs to Apple Health when you turn on Health sync.
